title: HtmlCaption
responsibility: Renders the native caption element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlCaption.attributes
inputs.description: Native caption attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: HtmlCaption.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native caption element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: HtmlCaption
outputs.description: The actual native caption element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
